title: SOC2 morning riff & quick to-dos
body:
Quick morning riff / scratchpad for SOC2 work - things I want to move today, plus notes to self. Not polished, just the running brain dump.

TODAY (high level)
- triage incoming evidence uploads from QA (see GDrive folder: drive:shared_drives/company/misc/soc2-uploads)
- finish vendor risk checklist for LogStreamX and AcmeKMS (send to Anika for review)
- update control mapping doc with last week's test results (Control Matrix link above)

PRIORITY TODOs (short checklist)
[ ] Accept and tag 3 evidence items from QA - file names start with "svc-logs-"
[ ] Confirm rotation date for KMS keys with Marcus (CC6.5)
[ ] Draft short note for Legal about third-party contract clause gap for data deletion (vendor: LogStreamX)
[ ] Add one more test case to automated evidence collector for SRE-runbook backups

EVIDENCE NOTES (quick)
- svc-logs-prod-20260328.tar.gz: looks like full log bundle, but missing index.json. Pinged QA at 09:12 — waiting for re-upload. Ticket: JIRA-LOG-1128.
- infra-audit-report-2026-03-20.pdf: good, includes syslog exports + signed reviewer note by Marcus. Move to evidence bucket folder and mark as "accepted".
- oncall-rotation-sheet.csv: owner column inconsistent (some entries nicknames). Need to ask SRE to normalize to employee IDs.

VENDOR REVIEW (notes / quick risk flags)
- LogStreamX (ingest/log retention svc)
  - onboarding checklist: ok, but data retention policy doesn't explicitly say customer-deleted copies are purged within 30 days.
  - ask CS/legal: do we have contract addendum for retention? If not, propose clause.
  - evidence to collect: export policy doc, SLA, SOC report if available.
- AcmeKMS (customer-managed keys option)
  - vendor provided HSM integration docs. Need to verify: key rotation frequency and KMIP compliance.
  - gap: no audit logs for key-access in the standard plan. Check if enterprise plan has audit trail exports.

QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- Who has admin on the evidence GDrive folder? I tried to change permission and got an error at 09:20. If it's not me, escalate to infra team.
- Need a final decision on whether test snapshots are acceptable as "evidence" for CC6.2. Product wants to treat snapshot metadata as acceptable; control owner (Marcus) prefers full export.

QUICK ACTIONS (what I'll do this morning)
- 09:30 ping Anika with vendor checklist draft (DM slack @anika).
- 10:00 triage QA uploads and tag accepted/reject with short reason.
- 11:00 short meeting with Marcus (15m) to confirm KMS rotation window and who signs audit evidence.

SNIPPETS / COMMANDS I keep using
- AWS list objects for evidence S3: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-soc2-evidence/ --recursive --human-readable | grep svc-logs
- quick sql to check rotation table: SELECT key_id, last_rotated_at FROM kms_keys WHERE last_rotated_at < now() - interval '90 days';

RANDOM NOTES / THOUGHTS
- Might be worth a tiny script that verifies file naming convention on upload and auto-tags (prefix svc-logs- / infra-audit- / confluence-export-). Save dev time.
- Keep the "accepted evidence" folder lean—make a README that lists what the accepted formats are (pdf with signature, tar.gz + index.json, csv with employee_id).

NEXT STEPS / FOLLOW UPS
- After triage: update control matrix row for CC6.2 with evidence links.
- Draft vendor clause language and send to Legal for quick review (2–3 sentence change).
- Build a ticket for infra to grant me admin on evidence folder if they confirm policy allows it.

MINOR LOG (timestamps)
- 09:05: skimmed infra-audit-report, flagged missing signature on page 3.
- 09:12: asked QA to re-upload svc-logs bundle (JIRA-LOG-1128).
- 09:20: permission error when trying to change GDrive sharing.

End of riff — will tidy this into a proper checklist after I get the re-uploads. Keep short notes here for quick reference.

---
Meta: this is a personal working doc. Move to shared 'security' folder when polished.
